detail.text:
All checks pass. I've implemented rate limiting for auth (signup/login) at 10 requests per minute per client IP, and for link creation at 30 requests per hour per user ID. The implementation uses in-memory sliding window counters with sync.Mutex and periodic cleanup. The test `TestRateLimitLogin` verifies that the 11th login attempt within a minute returns 429.

Recommend merging: the implementation meets all acceptance criteria, passes all checks including gosec and race detection, and follows the repository's conventions.
